name: rounding-order/hard-to-kill-cap-runs-after-slow
source: game: Hook.ModifyDamage (one decimal through the additive and multiplicative modifiers, the caps after, one int cast)
doc: 9 x 1.2 = 10.8, capped at 10 by HARD_TO_KILL_POWER after SLOW_POWER.

xfail_engines.old: old has no SLOW_POWER in the multiplicative chain and holds its count as a separate buff (hook_open: missing SLOW_POWERPower.ModifyDamageMultiplicative; fix/rounding-order 2935e9ff not landed).
xfail_engines.core2: old has no SLOW_POWER in the multiplicative chain and holds its count as a separate buff (hook_open: missing SLOW_POWERPower.ModifyDamageMultiplicative; fix/rounding-order 2935e9ff not landed); core2 runs old's rules until its family switch is on (migrated_families.json), so it fails the same way.
